name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

product.governing_security_rule: Career != Organisation Role != Project Role != Permission

authentication_and_tenancy.tenant_authority: active NuBlox user + active organisation_members row
authentication_and_tenancy.selected_organisation_cookie: selection hint only; server revalidates membership
authentication_and_tenancy.signup_policy: fail-closed; exactly one valid invitation or organisation-bootstrap intent
authentication_and_tenancy.foreign_record_policy: tenant-owned foreign public IDs are masked where disclosure would leak tenant identity

permission_model.umbrella_policy: resolve granular key first; same-domain umbrella applies only when granular has no explicit member/role decision; explicit granular deny cannot be bypassed
permission_model.cross_domain_policy: permission umbrellas never cross domain families

standard_roles.bootstrap_parity: Existing-tenant forward-migration grants and future OrganisationBootstrapService grants are persisted and integration-tested for released finance authority families.

implemented_workflow: Controlled Reminder Dispatch and Retry Evidence
Separate VAT Relief Authorisation and Reversal
VAT Return Box 1 Repayment Posting Evidence

authoritative_position.invoice_outstanding_formula: issued invoice gross - issued credit-note gross - active payment allocations - active write-offs
authoritative_position.customer_position: sum positive outstanding issued invoices per customer/currency
authoritative_position.void_policy: voided invoices contribute no receivable exposure
authoritative_position.unallocated_cash_policy: unallocated cash does not reduce customer receivable until allocated
authoritative_position.write_off_policy: only active authorised write-offs reduce receivable; reversal restores the amount

payment_capacity.formula: payment amount - active invoice allocations - active bad-debt recoveries
payment_capacity.reversal_policy: a payment with active bad-debt recovery usage cannot be reversed until recovery is explicitly reversed

tax_configuration.provisioning_policy: idempotent; matching tenant categories and existing rate history are preserved
tax_configuration.invoice_line_policy: invoice draft lines require explicit tax selection and issue refreshes the selected category against the issue-date effective rate
tax_configuration.deliberate_non_claim: construction domestic reverse-charge invoice treatment is not represented as ordinary 0% tax

credit_control.serialization: customer-first invoice locking and current/locking receivable reads prevent concurrent invoice issue or write-off mutation from racing a commitment decision

bad_debt.dependency_policy: 004K active VAT relief claims block write-off reversal; active VAT repayment evidence blocks operational recovery reversal

vat_bad_debt_relief.name: Controlled VAT Bad-Debt Relief
vat_bad_debt_relief.status: implemented on PR #33 pending exact documentation-synchronised release gate
workflow: prepared source-tax-linked claim and eligibility attestations

eligibility_policy.relevant_date: later of supply date and payment due date
eligibility_policy.issued_due_date_guard: when invoice due_date exists it is authoritative and operator input must match
attestations: VAT accounted for and paid to HMRC

calculation_policy.claim_vat: immutable source invoice VAT × claim consideration basis ÷ source gross
calculation_policy.repayment_vat: authorised claim VAT × recovered consideration ÷ authorised claim consideration
calculation_policy.arithmetic: fixed-point decimal; operator does not enter VAT relief/repayment amounts

posting_policy.claim: Box 4; amount derived from authorised claim VAT; VAT-period end within eligibility/deadline window
posting_policy.repayment: Box 1; amount derived from proportional VAT repayment; VAT period must contain actual operational recovery received date
posting_policy.boundary: posting evidence only; no HMRC submission or complete VAT-return engine

vat_bad_debt_relief.reversal_policy: claim, repayment and VAT-return posting corrections are additive reversal facts; downstream evidence must be reversed before upstream operational facts
regulatory_sources_checked: GOV.UK VAT Notice 700/18 — Relief from VAT on bad debts
GOV.UK HMRC VBDR4100 — Repayment of relief when subsequent payments received
GOV.UK HMRC VBDR4200 — How and when repayment is made
GOV.UK HMRC VBDR1600 — What time limits apply for claiming relief?
deliberate_non_claims: automatic proof of external VAT/legal eligibility facts

database_types.composition: DatabaseSchema = CoreDB & CollectionsDB; Database and DatabaseExecutor both use DatabaseSchema

validation.generated_kysely_drift: zero across core + collections outputs required
validation.status: final documentation-synchronised Package 004K head must prove the complete gate before merge

deliberate_exclusions: statutory general-ledger posting / double-entry journal engine
direct HMRC VAT Return / Making Tax Digital submission
complete VAT account / VAT control account

next_boundary.name: Controlled General-Ledger Posting and Accounting Export Evidence
recommended_sequence: inspect the existing Package 004 reference/accounting structures before adding journal facts
define tenant chart-of-accounts/accounting-mapping prerequisites without coupling careers to authority
derive posting candidates from immutable invoice, credit-note, payment, write-off and VAT-relief events
record balanced posting batches/export evidence without mutating operational source facts
make accounting corrections additive through reversal/reposting evidence
keep bank reconciliation, FX and direct tax-authority submission as separate later boundaries
next_boundary.governing_rule: accounting posting/export must be explicit balanced auditable evidence linked to immutable operational source events; operational documents and cash facts are never rewritten to make accounting history fit

open_product_gaps: general/direct contract creation independent of accepted-quotation conversion
Package 003 accepted-quotation conversion evidence for a legitimate already-existing source-estimate project
